name: Rago Fabrication
old_description: 2010-2024 5th Gen Toyota 4Runner Molle Storage Panel System | Pair
about:
Rago Fabrication operates from Chandler, Arizona, where it designs and manufactures overlanding and off-road accessories for a wide range of vehicle platforms. The company's founding year, ownership structure, and founders are not publicly disclosed on its website.

The company's core product lines include MOLLE storage panels, roof racks and ladder systems, off-road bumpers, light brackets, skid plates and rock sliders, on-board air systems, battery and electrical accessories, and bed racks with rail systems. These items are developed for specific vehicle generations spanning Toyota (4Runner, Tacoma, Land Cruiser, Tundra, Sequoia, FJ Cruiser), Lexus (GX 550, GX 460, GX 470), Subaru (Forester, Crosstrek, Outback), Ineos Grenadier, Rivian R1T, Ford Bronco, Chevrolet/GMC Canyon and Colorado, Jeep Gladiator, and Nissan Frontier and Xterra. Rago Fabrication also stocks and sells lighting products from brands such as Rigid Industries, Baja Designs, KC HiLites, Nacho Offroad Lighting, and DV8 Elite Series.

Customers are primarily overlanding enthusiasts, off-road recreational users, and commercial upfitters who need vehicle-specific mounting and protection solutions. The company sells directly through its website and supports a dealer network for broader distribution.

Rago Fabrication emphasizes fit, finish, and attention to detail as its benchmark, stating its products are "designed tough so you can trust they'll stand up to any job." In 2024 the company announced permanent price reductions on core items including MOLLE panels, ditch brackets, and cross bars.

name: Rainier Woodworking Co
old_description: We will create the right solution from your vision, or we can surprise you with a finished product that you wont be disappointed with.
about:
Rainier Woodworking Co operates from a facility at 2615 South 80th Street in Tacoma, Washington. The company has served the Greater Puget Sound region for many years, producing cabinetry for local designers and dealers. Its roots are in the Pacific Northwest, where it has built a reputation for locally made wood products.

The shop manufactures a superior line of cabinetry sold exclusively through professional kitchen and bath designers and dealers along the West Coast. Production focuses on custom solutions built to client specifications, with an emphasis on heirloom-quality wood construction. The company also offers a design collaboration process, creating products from a client’s vision or delivering finished pieces.

Primary customers include independent kitchen and bath designers and dealerships that specify Rainier products for residential projects. The company also works directly with design professionals to develop custom pieces. Its distribution network spans the West Coast, serving professional designers and some of the best kitchen & bath dealers.

Rainier Woodworking highlights its commitment to fair pricing, working within client budgets and timelines. The company also stresses sustainable material sourcing, noting a deep regard for the trees that supply its wood, and offers a proprietary project-tracking app called RW CabTracker.

about:
Ramco Automotive, based in Miami, Florida, was founded in 2007 by industry veterans with 40 years of combined experience. The company began as an independent manufacturer and distributor of electrical and electronic replacement parts for motor vehicles.

The company produces a range of sensors and components including crankshaft position sensors, idle air control valves, camshaft position sensors, fuel pressure regulators, coolant temperature sensors, ignition control modules, ignition coils, and knock detonation sensors. Ramco operates an online platform that serves distributors and retailers, offering both its own RAMCO brand and products from other aftermarket manufacturers. The catalog complies with ACES and PIES data management standards.

Ramco serves the automotive aftermarket, original equipment (OE), and original equipment service (OES) markets. Its customer base includes distributors and retailers across the United States, Latin America, Europe, and the Middle East.

The company emphasizes honesty, quality, reliability, and timely delivery. Its mission is to be the leading independent supplier to the automotive aftermarket by providing high-quality products, competitive pricing, and strong customer service while operating in an environmentally responsible manner.

name: Ramco Solutions
old_description: Let us help you solve your food conveyance issues. From packaging conveyors, meat conveyors, cook plant conveyors and much more.
about:
Ramco Solutions operates from Laurel, Delaware, where it emerged as the successor to Planned Poultry Renovations, a company Brian Ramey co‑founded in 1995 after a career that began at Perdue Farms in 1983 and continued as engineering manager at Townsend’s. The business remains family‑owned, with Ramey’s son Kolby and daughter Hali now involved in its direction.

The shop designs, fabricates, and installs food‑grade conveyance systems — packaging, meat, and cook‑plant conveyors — along with mezzanines, maintenance platforms, trench covers, and vacuum equipment. In‑house capabilities span 4 kW fiber‑laser cutting (up to 1 in. mild steel), 180‑ton press‑brake forming, 110‑ton ironworking, TIG/MIG/stick welding, 3D LIDAR scanning, Autodesk Inventor modeling, and additive manufacturing in polycarbonate, carbon‑fiber blends, and Ultem. A proprietary Ramcoat non‑slip coating is applied to stair treads, floor plates, and other metal surfaces.

Primary customers are poultry and food‑processing plants, as well as broader food‑and‑beverage manufacturers that need hygienic, modular material‑handling solutions. The company also supplies components to other builders of food‑grade machinery.

Ramco was created to bring plug‑and‑play conveyor designs, standardized parts, and a streamlined quoting process to an industry that often relies on custom‑one‑off engineering. Its stated mission emphasizes pioneering new equipment through R&D, while its safety program includes OSHA 30/10, Highwire, Avetta, and ISN certifications.

name: Ramtel Corporation
old_description: Ramtel specializes in Custom Silk Screened phone panels, individualized to your needs
about:
Ramtel Corporation, based in Johnston, Rhode Island, was founded in 1983 as Ramtech following the divestiture of the telephone industry and a collaboration with an Ivy League university in New England. The company set out to solve the vandalism and durability problems of standard receiver phones by developing the first hands-free security phone.

Today Ramtel manufactures a range of security communication products including custom silk-screened phone panels, one-button and dual-purpose hands-free phones in standard and mini sizes, multi-button phones, elevator phones with stainless steel panels, and area-of-refuge phones. The company fabricates its own non-rusting stainless steel columns, anodizes aluminum panels, applies conformal coating to electronics, and performs in-house quality assurance testing at every production stage. All products are assembled in the USA.

Ramtel serves safety and security integrators, educational institutions (K‑12), campus security departments, elevator contractors, and commercial building owners. Its phones are compatible with more than 30 PBX and VoIP platforms—including Avaya, Cisco, Asterisk, and Siemens—and are deployed for emergency assistance, elevator communication, entrance security, and area-of-refuge applications.

The company emphasizes that it is the only U.S. manufacturer producing non-rusting stainless steel columns, and it differentiates itself through a fierce commitment to custom solutions, rapid introduction of new features, and end‑to‑end customer support from engineering through installation.

name: Ray's Western Wear & Saddlery
old_description: Exceptional fit, built-in stretch, and dependable durability.
about:
Ray's Western Wear & Saddlery operates from Oacoma, South Dakota, a location it has occupied since 1996 when the business moved to capture Interstate 90 traffic. The company traces its roots to April 1957, when Ray Steckelberg purchased a men's clothing store in nearby Chamberlain and began selling horse tack from the basement. The Steckelberg family has retained ownership across four generations; today the store is led by great‑granddaughter Brooke and her husband Kaiden, continuing a legacy that spans more than 65 years.

The store functions as a full‑line western retailer, stocking a wide assortment of boots, denim, seasonal apparel, and equestrian tack. Its sales floor emphasizes boot variety — marketed as the largest selection in the state — and includes a dedicated tack room where saddle and horse‑fitting services are offered. Brands carried include Ariat footwear and apparel, as well as specialty items such as SoGlo grooming tape. The operation runs from a single retail location; no manufacturing or wholesale distribution is described.

Customers range from local ranchers and rodeo competitors to travelers pulling horse trailers along I‑90. The business serves the western lifestyle market, supplying both work‑oriented gear and fashion‑forward seasonal collections. Its client base spans the broader equestrian community and general consumers seeking durable western wear.

The company positions itself as "South Dakota's Cowboy Store," highlighting its family heritage, personalized fitting expertise, and a product mix built on fit, stretch, and durability. The transition from a basement tack operation to a destination retail outlet reflects a deliberate focus on serving the region's horse and ranch culture.

name: Ready Made Plastic Trays
old_description: Businesses have trusted our genuine, American-made trays since 1990.
about:
Founded in 1990 in Meridian, Idaho, Ready Made Plastic Trays operates as a licensed and certified thermoform plastic tray manufacturer serving businesses and the public. The company has built its reputation on American-made trays for packaging and storage applications.

The company manufactures high-precision trays using High Impact Polystyrene (HIPS), offering food-grade, medical-grade, and anti-static variants in stock configurations with round, square, or rectangular pockets. An in-house CNC tooling shop supports custom fixture design up to two inches deep, enabling tailored solutions for complex component shapes. Both stock and custom orders are fulfilled with domestic and international shipping.

Customers span aerospace, automotive, dental, electronics, firearms, food and beverage, machining, manufacturing, medical, optical, medical devices, and mechanical sectors. The firm highlights long-term relationships with clients in medical device shipping and aerospace component protection.

Ready Made emphasizes domestically sourced materials traceable to original manufacturers, ISO 9001:2015 certification, and a no-nonsense ordering process with volume discounts. The company attributes its longevity to rapid production turnaround and a commitment to personal service, with customers noting consistent delivery since 2009.

name: Real Steel Manufacturing
old_description: We are an AWS certified welding facility, providing domestic and international service.
about:
Real Steel Manufacturing operates from Muskegon Heights, Michigan, as an AWS-certified welding facility serving domestic and international customers. The business is run by Rick and Kelli, who oversee daily operations and customer relationships. While the exact founding year is not publicly disclosed, the company has established itself as a full-service metal fabrication and machining shop.

The shop provides a range of metalworking services under one roof: fabrication and welding (including aluminum specialization), CNC machining, assembly, coating and finishing, and post-weld heat treatment. Equipment includes CNC laser and plasma cutting systems for sheet and plate, CNC bending and bump-forming capabilities, and media blasting for surface preparation. In-house fixture design supports repeat production runs, and the facility handles turn-key projects from raw material through finished assembly.

Customers span industrial sectors requiring welded vessels, structural components, and machine-grade aluminum parts. Testimonials reference process vessels up to 14 feet in diameter and complex internal fixtures, indicating work for heavy industrial and process equipment manufacturers. The company emphasizes quick turnaround, quoting one-week shipping for small-to-medium assemblies and four weeks for larger, tight-tolerance builds.

Real Steel positions itself on speed and vertical integration — offering in-house machining of weldments, coating, and assembly to reduce lead times and avoid the cost of traditional machining for aluminum components. The founders' hands-on approach is highlighted in client feedback, which cites attention to weld quality, paint finish, and logistics coordination as distinguishing factors.

name: Real Wood Furniture
old_description: The Home of Real Wood Furniture: Serving the Metro DC Area: Northern Virginia - NOVA - Maryland - Washington, DC - District of Columbia
about:
Real Wood Furniture operates from Chantilly, Virginia, serving the Washington DC metropolitan area including Northern Virginia, Maryland, and the District of Columbia. The company does not publish its founding date, ownership structure, or founder names.

The company produces solid wood furniture for residential and office settings, offering factory-finished, finished-to-order, and unfinished pieces in styles such as Shaker, modern, contemporary, traditional, mission, Amish, and barn wood. It works with pine, maple, oak, cherry, alder, reclaimed lumber, and parawood, and emphasizes that its products contain no particle board. Both standard and build-to-order options are available across categories including bedroom, dining, living room, home office, entertainment, wall units, and youth furniture.

Real Wood Furniture sells directly to consumers and businesses throughout Northern Virginia, Maryland, and the District of Columbia, furnishing homes, home offices, and commercial offices. Its product range covers every room, from bedroom and dining sets to home theater and library installations.

The company positions itself on value and material integrity, advertising the best furniture value in the region and highlighting its commitment to solid wood construction without particle board.
